image_context:
MRI BRAIN W/WO CONTRAST
Indication: 7 y/o M w/ staring spells and episodes of jerking of the R arm, eval for structural cause.
Findings: Multiple wedge-shaped T2/FLAIR bright lesions involving the cortex and subjacent white matter of both frontal lobes and the R parietal lobe. Several small nodules along the walls of the lateral ventricles, some calcified on prior CT. No enhancing mass at the foramen of Monro. Ventricles normal in size. Incidental mild leftward bowing of the nasal septum.

RENAL US
Multiple echogenic foci in both kidneys, largest 1.2 cm in the L lower pole, c/w fat-containing lesions (AMLs). No collecting system dilation.

image_findings.evidence: R parietal and bilat frontal lesions
